text: In July 2025 we spoke, most of us, of the "big beautiful bill." One hundred thirteen of us said those words, peaking on 2025-07-03; Kevin Hern said them first, on 2025-01-08. One hundred eleven of us said "one big beautiful bill." One hundred six said "the one big beautiful bill." Eighty of us reached for "one big beautiful bill act," and seventy-six for "the one big beautiful bill act." Beneath the name we carried its parts: fifty-three of us said "the largest tax," forty-five said "child tax credit," forty-four said "taxes on tips," each cresting the same day, 2025-07-03. We converged on one date and one phrase, and the record shows the convergence without our explaining it. This is what we said, and how many of us said it.
